svg.title: EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD is firmware in C++17 for the ESP32-S3 (ESP-IDF 5.5) with two board profiles, Ethernet and Wi-Fi. A program connects over TCP with an access token, arms the node and sends the bytes of a move; the node queues them and puts them on the serial line at the line's own pace, reads the machine's lamps and drives a spindle through a 0-10 V signal. A web panel with a side menu in 37 languages sets it up. The rules are tested on a computer and both images build; nothing has been flashed or run on a board.
